title: Live Session
noRecordingHint: Session recording is prohibited by platform policy — only metadata is saved (duration and attendance)

waiting.title: Waiting for the teacher
waiting.desc: The session room is open — video starts as soon as the teacher joins

camera.rearLive: The room is seeing your rear camera now

chat.empty: No messages yet — start the conversation

board.title: Shared whiteboard
board.writeBlocked: Writing is stopped by the teacher
board.docMissing: The shared file could not be loaded

link.noMedia: No video or audio from this participant

leave.title: Leave the session?
leave.descStudent: You will leave while the teacher and other students continue.
leave.descHost: You can simply leave, or end the session for everyone and save its summary.

summary.title: Session ended
summary.desc: There is no video recording — this is the saved session metadata:
summary.notePlaceholder: What was covered in this session?

notice.iceFailed: Could not load the connection settings from the server — the room is using public STUN only, so audio and video may fail on strict NAT networks.
notice.iceEmpty: The server returned an empty ICE server list — check the Meeting settings on the server.
notice.noMedia: No camera or microphone available — you joined as a viewer only; check the browser permission and re-enter.
notice.stageRejected: The server refused to change what is on the stage.
notice.docRejected: The server refused to show this file in the session.
notice.endFailed: The session could not be ended from the room — it can be ended from the sessions page.
notice.blockedMic: The teacher muted you in this session — the button stays off until they allow it again.
notice.blockedCamera: The teacher stopped your camera — it will not return from this button.
notice.noCameraTrack: No camera is live in this session, so there is nothing to flip.
notice.cameraUnsupported: This device has no other camera to flip to.
notice.cameraSwitchFailed: The camera could not be switched.
notice.cameraDeviceSwitched: Switched to another camera on this device.
notice.controlFailed: The server rejected the control — try again.
notice.fullscreenBlocked: The browser refused full screen for this tile.

share.unsupported: This browser cannot capture the screen — on a phone use the Rear camera button to film paper, or Open file to present from your library.
share.denied: Camera or screen permission is blocked — allow it in site settings and try again.
share.busy: The camera or screen is busy in another app (a call or another broadcast).

file.title: A file shown inside the session
file.desc: Pick a file from your library or from this device. Students see it under your pen immediately, and your writing stays on their screen even if they join late.
file.onlyImagesPdf: Inside a session only images and PDF files can be shown.
file.loadFailed: The file list could not be loaded.
